decisionLog.outcome: Reframed 2.3.2 as Student Life by Design. The deliverable will use evidence-led student personas as a design and assurance framework across King's Edge, identify unmet participation needs that should drive commissioning through 2.2.4, and shape a richer physical and digital student-life proposition without duplicating digital product delivery, analytics or substantive opportunity commissioning held elsewhere in the programme.

Agreed an indicative three-year direct investment profile of £30,000 in 2026/27, £50,000 in 2027/28 and £60,000 in 2028/29, focused on persona-led insight, participation design and physical/digital activation. Shared Deputy Director and Project Officer capacity remain costed centrally; substantive commissioned provision sits in 2.2.4, analytics in 2.3.1 and digital product delivery in 4.1.4.

Retained the £30,000 Year 1 Student Life discovery and prototype investment, but rebased the recommended Core scale and institutionalisation envelopes to £30,000 in 2027/28 and £30,000 in 2028/29. The Core case therefore preserves a real route from prototypes to wider adoption while expecting broader delivery to move increasingly through normal campus, faculty, service and KCLSU practice. A substantially larger multi-campus activation programme should be presented as an Enhanced option rather than embedded in the baseline.

Confirmed that the early £25,000 King's Talent purchasing route may support the existing Year 1 Student Life persona, evidence and tested-design work where paid student capacity is the most useful delivery mechanism. This does not create a new Student Life output: the required deliverables remain the evidence-led persona set, validation evidence, participation principles and tested design outputs already defined in 2.3.2.
decisionLog.notes: Any King's Talent spend attributed to 2.3.2 must be netted against the existing Year 1 Student Life direct/shared capacity assumptions rather than added on top. Digital product implementation remains outside 2.3.2 and within the separate Digital Student Experience Hub investment.
